text: hi my mum asked me to message bc shes on the phone to my dad. my little sister is 2. she was sick once earlier but shes kept all her drinks down since then, had a cup of water and some milk and nothing came back up. but shes being weird about the lights. when we put the big light on in the living room she screwed her face up and put her hands over her eyes and started crying and she keeps turning her head away from the lamp. she only stopped crying when we turned evrything off and sat with her in the dark. even the tv seems to bother her. her neck seems fine tho, she was looking down at her feet and playing with her toes no problem. mum wants to know if she needs to be seen tonite or what we shoud do
